race.comment: HOPEFUL CAUSE (1) resumes with a Deagon trial placing behind him and has already placed at this venue. Showed positive signs in his debut prep and has more upside then others. PARADISE AS USUAL (6) is right in the mix again after failing as favourite here last start, but there were some excuses. She's placed at this trip and she gets another good chance to finally get off the mark. COOL ADALINE (8) has been fifth in both runs at this track and is open to further improvement third-up. PUNGWE RIVER (3) backs up quickly after failing as an odds-on favourite at Murwillumbah, but his Eagle Farm third two starts ago keeps him right in the mix. MISS CHAMONIX (5) stretches to a more suitable trip third-up and can play a role late if the pace is genuine.
